LanguageData.VGE_GravjumperLaunch.label: light Hellion launch
LanguageData.VGE_GravjumperLaunch.description: Travel to a remote destination using a light Hellion. The pilot's skill is the most important factor in a safe launch, with the copilot providing a strong secondary contribution. Additional crew help only slightly. After departure, the old map can be kept or abandoned.
LanguageData.VGE_GravhulkLaunch.label: heavy Hellion launch
LanguageData.VGE_GravhulkLaunch.description: Travel to a remote destination using a heavy Hellion. Every crewmember aboard contributes to launch safety, while undersized thrusters provide no benefit. The instruments also gather flight data for Hellion-systems research. After departure, the old map can be kept or abandoned.
